name: ambiflex
description: Ambitious reasoning tree for Claude Code: Felix Rieseberg's Altitude / Depth / Range method, drawn live, steerable by touch, with autonomous execution and an end-to-end ETA.

wakeWord.description: Word that, at the start of any prompt (typed or dictated), applies the Ambiflex method: '<word> <task>', '<word> auto', '<word> stop', '<word> status'. Empty disables it.
wakeWord.title: Wake word

budgetUsd.description: Spending cap in USD for a plan run in auto mode (0 = none). Auto mode stops when it is reached.
budgetUsd.title: Budget (USD)

alertPct.description: Percent of the budget at which a warning is shown.
alertPct.title: Budget alert (%)

rateLimitAlertPct.description: Percent of a usage window (5-hour, 7-day) at which a warning is shown.
rateLimitAlertPct.title: Usage window alert (%)

hourlyRateUsd.description: Your own $/hour figure for cost projections (0 = measure it from this session, assumed before the first minutes).
hourlyRateUsd.title: Hourly rate (USD)
